nom: Peach Slices Snail Rescue Intensive Wash-Off Jelly Mask

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination skin notes the mask keeps her oily t-zone from looking oily, and another says it hydrates without an oily feeling.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, or postpartum-dry skin report strong hydration, softness, and reduced flaking, with several calling it their best product for dryness, though one dry-skin reviewer felt it left her skin dry and tight.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (dry cheeks, oily t-zone) describe it as balancing, leaving skin glowy and refreshed without excess oil.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report calming, soothing effects with no burning or breakouts, but a notable minority describe burning, red blotches, perioral dermatitis, or breakouts, especially with prolonged or frequent use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report smoother, more hydrated, less tired-looking skin and reduced need for foundation.

concerns.aging: Mature/aging-skin reviewers report smoothing, brightening, and a fresher, less tired complexion after use, with foundation described as less necessary.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers across skin types report significant hydration and softness, sometimes lasting into the next day; one reviewer felt it did not hydrate and only made skin feel dry and tight.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including those with rosacea and post-procedure irritation, report visibly reduced redness and a calming, cooling effect; a few instead report new redness, burning, or dermatitis appearing after repeated use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers recovering from over-exfoliation, retinol, microneedling, or dermaplaning report the mask calmed stinging and helped restore their barrier; one reviewer with a previously damaged barrier says she must be careful but finds this mask safe for her.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes the licorice root helped with hyperpigmentation and another mentions faded dark spots, but this is mentioned by only a couple of reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report reduced breakouts, faster healing of blemishes, and less redness around spots; however several others report new whiteheads, cystic-type flare-ups, or worsened acne-prone/sensitive skin after use.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of combination-skin reviewers report the mask hydrates without adding oiliness or greasiness.

aspects.libelle: Unique jelly texture enjoyable to apply
Good value for price/size of jar
Risk of allergic or dermatitis reaction with prolonged use

extraits.texte: It honestly did nothing for my skin but made it feel dry and tight in a bad way. Anyone getting any hydrating effects from this mask are probably getting the benefits from their other moisturizer and lotions they put on before this. The cheap Freeman masks work better than this does.

extraits.titre: Absolutely loved but had to stop using
extraits.texte: This product worked wonders on my face. I had bought the facial cleanser, mask, moisturizer, and toner. I must say they helped clear any redness, and breakouts you have almost instantly. But to be very honest my skin is sensitive and although this worked for a bit, i had started to develop a dermatitis around my mouth and face with prolong use. (Not saying everyone will develop this kind of reaction!) it just happened to me. And it most likely happened due to probably prolong use of teatree and the snail ingredients they have. At the end of the day if youre not so sensitive to certain ingredients, then this product could definitely work for you.

this is a NECESSITY for rosacea prone, sensitive, dry skin. it is so hydrating and is so soothing when I am having a rosacea flare up. it is a little hard to wash off but it helps my skin so much that I will deal with that every time

So I bought this just a day ago, as I was looking for a snail mucin product within a certain budget. Last night I decided I would let the product sit overnight (I know, it's not recommended to do that, but it worked for me). When I woke up this morning, obviously my face felt really tight, as the mask dried completely, but after I washed it off, I realized my skin just about completely cleared up (there's a bit of a breakout on my temple but it shrunk TREMENDOUSLY) and was softer and more glowy than ever. Now I should probably mention that I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin so I'm very surprised I didn't break out even more by doing this. I will say if for whatever reason you try the same thing, make sure to moisturize after washing it off. I just went in with some cocoa butter and my skin is thriving. This honestly would work pretty well as a spot treatment for stubborn breakouts, especially if you have sensitive skin like me and things like salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide make you even more sensitive

I have combination skin (dry cheeks, oily t-zone). This mask is my go-to all year round for keeping my skin refreshed and hydrated without making me look oily. It is so soothing and feels amazing! I wash it off with cooler water and my skin looks super glowy and refreshed after.

As someone who is of retirement age, finding a product that works for my mature, thinning skin is challenging. I can use this before my basic serum, cremes, etc, for very hydrated and smoother look to my skin. Foundation becomes less necessary. This is a must for a tired complexion before an evening out. I hope this product sells well and stays in Ulta's product choices.

love this stuff. whenever i can tell my skin is starting to get freaked out or irritated, i can trust that this mask will sort everything out! i wanted a jelly mask to soothe my skin — and ive tried other brands that do the job temporarily — but this is the only mask that manages to have that soothingness while also fighting breakouts and leaving such a noticeable effect. i've recommend to friends and family and the love it too! definitely a thick mask, and a sticky one, so sometimes i mix it with a tiny bit of water in my hands to make application easier. also have learned not to put anywhere, such as under the brow or near my eyelids, that may glue my eyes open, LOL. but the main mask in my regimen, definitely recommend to anyone with dehydrated, dry but acne-prone skin…i find it really hard to find products that check the box of hydrating but also blemish-fighting.
